articles.title: Democratic Officials Convene in Denver for Post-Election Strategy Session
articles.summary: A gathering of Democratic officials and strategists is underway in Denver to discuss the party's future after its best electoral performance in five decades.
articles.content: Democratic officials and strategists have descended upon Denver to revel in their party's best electoral performance in five decades and begin planning for the future. The city is abuzz with activity as these key figures converge on the What's Next conference, a two-day event hosted by Majority Democrats that had been months in the making. This gathering represents another crucial step forward for the party as it seeks to emerge from its post-2024 struggles. The conference promises to be a pivotal moment in the Democratic Party's journey. A key challenge facing these officials is how to capitalize on their newfound majorities in both chambers of Congress and control of at least 12 state legislative chambers. This shift in power dynamics has significant implications for the party's ability to drive policy changes. In his opening remarks, Mitch Landrieu, former Democratic mayor of New Orleans, emphasized the need for Democrats to rebuild the nation's foundation and fulfill America's promise, declaring "The fever has broken. The fog has lifted." As the dust settles from a midterm election season marked by surprises and upsets, Democrats in Denver have gathered to take stock of their wins and losses. The party's leaders are keenly aware that the recent victories were not solely due to the enthusiasm of their own supporters but also to the fact that many voters who cast ballots for Donald Trump in 2024 stayed home this time around. According to preliminary data, Democratic strategists attribute their success in part to a shift in voter behavior rather than a significant increase in party loyalty. As one analyst noted, the number crunchers are still trying to make sense of the numbers, but it's clear that many voters who defected two years ago have yet to rejoin the party. The party's focus on addressing pressing economic concerns has been touted as a key factor in winning back these disaffected voters, with Democrats arguing that their policies will resonate more closely with those struggling financially. The conference in Denver has attracted a diverse range of Democrats, including several high-profile figures who are being touted as potential presidential candidates for 2028. Among them are former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg and New Jersey Sen. Cory Booker, both of whom have gained significant attention in recent years. Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro is also in attendance. The gathering has been billed as a showcase for the party's rising talent, with many of its most promising young leaders taking to the stage to share their ideas and vision for the future. The event is being held at a concert venue in central Denver, which offers a unique backdrop for the proceedings. Outside, attendees can watch speakers on a large screen while enjoying food from local vendors. Denver itself is also getting a chance to shine as a modern example of a purple state turning solid blue. The city hosted the Democratic National Convention back in 2008 and is now competing with other locations to stage the event again in 2028. To boost its chances, Denver is highlighting its ability to attract voters from across the political spectrum. The conference has drawn attention for its focus on bridging the traditional left-center splits that have long plagued the party. The group Majority Democrats is seeking to position itself as a voice of reason and moderation, appealing to a new generation of leaders who are tired of old ideological battles. As Democrats gather in Denver for their post-midterms celebration, they are also taking a moment to reflect on their recent victories. To achieve this balance between introspection and jubilation, party leaders have organized town hall meetings where anyone can ask questions without fear of censorship or reprisal. In one such meeting, Iowa's new Governor Rob Sand explained his decision to hold unfiltered Q&A sessions in every county, allowing voters to express their concerns directly. He emphasized the importance of politicians listening to and answering questions honestly, as this is what voters expect from them. According to Sand, even if a question is critical or uncomfortable, it's better to address it head-on than to avoid it. The conference also offers a platform for party leaders like Hakeem Jeffries to engage with members who may be skeptical of the party's Washington power structure. Despite this, Jeffries' reputation as a likely next House speaker has generated some suspicion among those on the left. articles.summary: Spanish singer Rosalía made history last night by taking home the top prize of album of the year at the 2026 Latin Grammys for her critically acclaimed 2025 album "Lux.
articles.content: Spanish singer Rosalía made history last night by taking home the top prize of album of the year at the 2026 Latin Grammys for her critically acclaimed 2025 album "Lux. The highly anticipated ceremony took place in Las Vegas and marked a milestone moment for the artist, who has been making waves in the music industry with her innovative blend of classical and urban sounds. Rosalía kicked off the evening's festivities by delivering an emotional performance that showcased the depth and complexity of her new album. Her rendition of Lux" tracks "La Rumba Del Perdón," "La Perla" and "Dios Es Un Stalker was met with thunderous applause from the audience. The setlist was a testament to Rosalía's commitment to pushing boundaries and exploring new sounds, as she drew inspiration from her classical training and infused it with urban beats. Her performance also featured angelic dancers adorned in halos, adding an ethereal quality to the proceedings. The album Lux has been widely praised for its offbeat yet heartfelt approach to storytelling, which draws on the lives of female saints as a source of inspiration. The project's unique blend of classical and urban elements has resonated with fans and critics alike, cementing Rosalía's status as one of the most innovative artists in the industry. Rosalía's win marked a triumphant conclusion to an evening that saw her take home not one but two major awards: album of the year for Lux and song of the year for La Perla. The Latin Grammy Awards ceremony in Las Vegas was a whirlwind of excitement as performers took to the stage to showcase their talents. Daddy Yankee's high-energy performance featured a medley of his hit songs, including Ella Me Levantó", "Con Calma" and "Gasolina. He also collaborated with several notable artists, including Bizarrap, Bad Gyal and Feid. The ceremony paused momentarily as Janet Jackson took the stage to present Daddy Yankee with an award, her speech filled with admiration and respect for the Puerto Rican artist. As the host of the evening, Roselyn Sánchez brought her own brand of energy to the proceedings, guiding viewers through a night that promised many more highlights and surprises. The evening's performances showcased exceptional talent and musical diversity. Karol G took center stage with Ese Hombre es Malo, a música mexicana ballad that featured a full orchestra and 12 Mariachis in perfect harmony. Mon Laferte delivered a soulful performance of her song Femme Fatale, tugging at the heartstrings of the audience. Silvana Estrada's Dime was a cultural bridge, combining Venezuelan heritage with her signature cuatro instrument to create a unique sound experience. Kany García stunned with an acoustic rendition of La Niña Que Fui, while Jorge Drexler brought theater-like ambiance with his performance of Las Palabras. Milo J, the Argentine rapper, performed Solifican12" and "Gil in collaboration with Latin American folk icon Gustavo Santaolalla. Brazilian superstar Anitta took the stage for a medley of her hits from Equilibrium, blending Brazilian funk, samba, bossa nova, semba, reggae, electronic pop, and performed in multiple languages. Later, she returned to accept an award for Portuguese language contemporary pop album, using her speech to highlight the Black culture of Brazil. The 2026 Latin Grammy Awards ceremony featured several emotional tributes to music legends. One such tribute was a heartfelt performance of Te Solté la Rienda by The Warning, which paid respects to the late José Alfredo Jiménez. Reik also took the stage to perform his rendition of La Media Vuelta, while Sofía Reyes and Yami Safdie delivered a powerful duet of Si Nos Dejan. Camila Fernández brought the house down with her energetic performance of El Rey. Following this tribute, Rosalía returned to the stage for an electrifying performance of Serpiente De Cascabel. However, she wasn't done yet. Soon after, she headed back out onto the stage once more. This time, it was to present awards in various categories. Karol G took home a trophy for her album Tropicoqueta, which won the award for urban music album. Xavi's debut at the Latin Grammys continued with his win for contemporary Mexican album for Dosis. Fonseca also received a prize, this one for contemporary tropical album, for his album Antes Que El Tiempo Se Vaya. Among the evening's notable winners was Colombian singer Aria Vega, who took home the award for best new artist. Her acceptance speech was marked by tears of joy as she thanked her team and fans. This year saw a change in the eligibility criteria for this category, with only artists having fewer than three albums or 25 singles released being considered for the award. The Premiere Ceremony preceding the main event was where most of the evening's awards were announced. Among those recognized was Bobby Pulido, who took home the Latin Grammy for best Tejano album for his release Bobby Pulido & Friends: Una Tuya y Una Mía (Vol. 2/En Vivo). This achievement comes just days after a significant milestone in Pulido's life - he secured a seat in the House of Representatives for the Democrats by flipping a Texas district seat. In his acceptance speech, Pulido made a heartfelt announcement: I want to tell you that I'm retiring from music, and I'm leaving with so much gratitude." articles.title: Quantum Photonic Integrated Circuits Show Promise for Large-Scale Production
articles.summary: A team of engineers from Purdue University has made significant progress in developing quantum photonic integrated circuits that use photons as their basic units, known as qubits.
articles.content: Researchers have been working on developing quantum computers that can perform calculations at incredible speeds, potentially surpassing those of supercomputers. A key challenge in building these machines has been finding a way to harness the speed of light as a fundamental component. A team of engineers from Purdue University has made significant progress in addressing this issue by creating potential solutions for fabricating chips that use photons as their basic units, known as qubits. These quantum photonic integrated circuits hold promise for large-scale production. Conventional computers rely on bits to process information, which can only exist in a state of zero or one at any given time. In contrast, qubits are able to represent both zero and one simultaneously due to the phenomenon of superposition. This allows them to greatly expand the amount of information processed. Photons have several advantages over other quantum particles that could be used for building qubits. One major benefit is their ability to transfer data at the speed of light, eliminating delays in algorithm performance. Additionally, photons are relatively stable and can operate at room temperature without being disrupted by heat or other changes in their surroundings. Other types of qubits require extremely low temperatures to function, resulting in significant energy consumption. This makes photons an attractive option for building more efficient and powerful quantum computers. The development of these chips is still in its early stages, but the potential implications are vast. Quantum photonic integrated circuits could revolutionize fields such as cryptography, optimization, and simulation by allowing for faster and more complex calculations to be performed. Researchers have been working to overcome significant hurdles in creating quantum photonic integrated circuits, which rely on single photons as their building blocks. According to Vladimir Shalaev, a leading expert in this field, one of the major challenges lies in producing good single-photon sources. Shalaev and his colleague Alexandra Boltasseva are at the forefront of this research at Purdue University's Elmore Family School of Electrical and Computer Engineering. Their contributions have not gone unnoticed, as they have both been recognized on the Clarivate Highly Cited Researchers list for their work that has consistently ranked in the top 1% of citations in the Web of Science. Boltasseva's expertise has also earned her a spot on the Quantum 100 list, which was part of the United Nations' International Year of Quantum Science and Technology. This recognition highlights her significant contributions to the field of quantum science and technology. A crucial aspect of building a quantum photonic integrated circuit is generating single photons that can be used as qubits. However, achieving this has proven to be a difficult task due to the inconsistent and inefficient nature of current methods. Shalaev and Boltasseva have made significant progress in addressing this challenge by developing a method for emitting single photons using silicon nitride, a widely accepted material for constructing quantum photonic platforms. In 2021, they published a study in Science Advances that demonstrated the effectiveness of their approach. Their new method generates exactly one photon at room temperature from numerous locations on a silicon nitride platform every time it is exposed to a laser beam. This breakthrough has the potential to overcome some of the limitations associated with current methods for photon emission. The researchers have successfully created atomic defects within their platform to serve as sources of photon emission. These defects are responsible for limiting light emission to a single photon at a time, which is a crucial aspect of quantum computing. By introducing these defects, the team has been able to harness the speed of light in a more controlled manner. To further refine their approach, Shalaev and Boltasseva have developed a method to control the placement and number of defects within the platform. This involves embedding the atomic defects in nanosized pillars on the silicon nitride substrate, which enables the creation of uniform platforms for use in quantum photonic integrated circuits. One of the key challenges facing researchers in this field is the difficulty of controlling single photons as they interact with each other. In a conventional computer, switches called transistors toggle bits between zero and one states to process information, but in quantum computing, such control mechanisms are not readily available. To address this issue, Shalaev and Boltasseva's team has developed a switch capable of operating at the level of single photons. This proof-of-concept switch adapts a mechanism used in industry for modulating light with high-intensity light beams, known as optical nonlinearity. This mechanism involves using a "control" light beam to interact with a "probe beam, but at power levels that are typically too high for use with single photons. However, the researchers have successfully adapted this approach to work within the constraints of quantum computing. The development of such a switch is an important step towards creating functional quantum photonic integrated circuits, which would enable the processing and manipulation of information using the principles of quantum mechanics. The Purdue team's innovative method involves a single photon striking silicon, triggering an avalanche of electrons that alters light's passage through a material and changes its refractive index. This unique property allows the probe beam to pass through the device only when a single photon initiates the electron avalanche process, effectively switching the beam on and off. By manipulating the refractive index in this way, the team has made significant progress towards creating functional quantum photonic integrated circuits. However, even with photons, which are less susceptible to external influences, decoherence remains a major concern. This phenomenon occurs when a single disturbance causes qubits to fall out of superposition or entanglement, resulting in errors during calculations. The researchers have been working to prevent decoherence by anticipating it before it happens. The team's approach involves analyzing the patterns underlying decoherence using machine learning algorithms. By recognizing these patterns, they can predict and proactively control decoherence rather than simply responding to its occurrence. This proactive strategy is crucial for maintaining the integrity of quantum computations. According to Dr. Boltasseva, decoherence appears random but actually follows a discernible pattern that can be identified with machine learning techniques. The researchers have used statistical-physics analysis to uncover this pattern and then employed machine learning to validate their findings. This validation demonstrates the potential of using machine learning to predict decoherence patterns. The team's research has led to the development of a framework that learns and anticipates the dynamics of quantum systems, enabling proactive control of decoherence. By recognizing and predicting decoherence patterns, this framework provides a crucial tool for maintaining the stability of quantum computations. The Purdue team's innovative approach holds promise for advancing the field of quantum computing. The researchers' work has been published in Nature Communications, showcasing their significant contribution to understanding decoherence and developing strategies to mitigate its effects on quantum systems. By pushing the boundaries of machine learning and statistical-physics analysis, the team is making important strides towards creating more robust and efficient quantum computers. The team's framework has enabled them to tackle one of the major causes of decoherence in quantum systems: spectral diffusion. This phenomenon occurs when an emitted photon changes frequency due to disorder in its surroundings, affecting its energy level and compromising superposition. Spectral shifts exhibit a predictable temporal pattern, as they retain a memory of how an emitted photon's frequency has varied over time. The researchers developed an algorithm that incorporates this memory mechanism, allowing them to predict future spectral shifts based on data from individual quantum emitters. By training their algorithm on real-world data, the team demonstrated that it can accurately forecast spectral shifts and reduce decoherence by as much as 20-fold in certain quantum systems. This is a significant breakthrough, as it could have a substantial impact on the performance of quantum computers. Decoherence is an inherent aspect of nature, but recognizing its patterns and learning to control it can minimize its effects. As Shalaev noted, You can't get rid of decoherence, it's the law of nature that everything fluctuates." This new approach could simplify the process of running complex algorithms on quantum computers by reducing the number of qubits required. For instance, if errors caused by decoherence are minimized, a particular algorithm might only need 100 qubits instead of the usual 10,000. The potential for this method extends beyond individual systems, as it may lay the groundwork for anticipating decoherence across multiple quantum systems simultaneously. By combining these predictions with active tuning techniques, different emitters could be kept in closer alignment, enhancing the indistinguishability and synchronization of photons generated by each one. This development has significant implications for building scalable quantum architectures that can support large-scale quantum computing. The team is now focused on extracting hidden properties from a quantum system's fluctuating environment using statistical physics tools. These physical insights will be incorporated into machine-learning models to enhance their ability to predict decoherence and mitigate its effects on the quantum state. By understanding the microscopic processes responsible for spectral shifts, the researchers aim to develop predictive models that can identify potential decoherence before it disrupts the quantum state significantly, ultimately paving the way for more efficient and reliable quantum computing. articles.title: Lunar Industrialization Sparks Concerns Over Environmental Protection
articles.summary: Experts warn that large-scale industrialization of the moon could have severe consequences for its ecosystem, including irreversible environmental damage.
articles.content: Reports are emerging of a growing trend in lunar industrialization, with major powers and private companies racing to develop infrastructure and extract resources from the moon. However, this push has raised significant concerns about environmental protection, international regulation, and who will ultimately benefit from these activities. Experts warn that large-scale industrialization could have severe consequences for the moon's delicate ecosystem. The issue is being scrutinized by researchers at Vilnius University Institute of International Relations and Political Science, who are calling for a temporary halt on lunar development. According to their findings, published in the journal Global Environmental Politics, a moratorium would provide an opportunity to establish international regulations and foster public debate about the merits and drawbacks of lunar industrialization. This pause would allow policymakers to weigh the potential risks against any benefits. The researchers emphasize that irreversible environmental damage is a major concern, as well as disruptions to scientific research and the moon's cultural significance. They propose a temporary moratorium on industrial development to mitigate these risks and give stakeholders time to discuss and agree on best practices for lunar exploitation. This approach would enable policymakers to address the complex issues surrounding lunar industrialization in a more informed and collaborative manner. The debate over lunar industrialization has significant implications, not only for the moon but also for Earth's environment and international relations. As plans for lunar development continue to unfold, experts are urging caution and calling for a pause on large-scale industrial activities until a clearer understanding of the risks and benefits can be established. The outcome of this discussion will shape the future of space exploration and utilization, with far-reaching consequences for our planet and its inhabitants. As plans for lunar industrialization continue to gain momentum, experts are sounding the alarm on the need for greater international cooperation and governance in space exploration. The sheer scale of development currently being planned by nations such as the United States and China, as well as private space companies, raises concerns about unequal access to lunar resources. Those who establish infrastructure first could potentially gain a significant advantage over others, effectively controlling access to certain areas of the moon. This raises questions about the potential for exclusive territories on the moon, with powerful players asserting their dominance through the development of large-scale infrastructure projects. According to experts, this would be a far cry from the collaborative and inclusive approach that space exploration should represent. The lack of clear international governance in space law is seen as a major contributor to these concerns, allowing powerful nations and corporations to carve out exclusive territories on the moon without accountability or oversight. As governments and corporations continue to push for lunar industrialization, experts are sounding a warning call for caution. Rabitz suggests that greater involvement from citizens, civil society, scientists, and governments could help shape the trajectory of these activities, but acknowledges it may be challenging to constrain the ambitions of major space powers. A more inclusive international discussion is needed before large-scale industrial activities begin on the moon, ensuring decisions prioritize environmental protection and humanity's interests. This approach would prevent powerful nations and corporations from exploiting the lunar resources without accountability or consideration for the long-term consequences. The call for a pause on lunar industrialization emphasizes that the moon should not be treated as a frontier to be exploited without regulation, but rather as a shared resource that requires careful management and planning for its future use. articles.summary: Pete Crow-Armstrong has been crowned the MVP of the National League after a stellar regular season in which he hit .280/.372/.570.
articles.content: Pete Crow-Armstrong has been crowned the MVP of the National League, capping off a stellar regular season that left little doubt about his impressive skills on the field. The 24-year-old Cubs player's award win is not surprising given his exceptional performance, which included hitting .280/.372/.570 with outstanding defensive capabilities. He also led the league in home runs, tying him with Kyle Schwarber, and significantly improved his on-base skills. This achievement marks a significant milestone in Crow-Armstrong's career. Looking back at history, only eight center fielders have achieved at least 8.0 WAR in a season before turning 25: Willie Mays, Mickey Mantle, Willie Davis, César Cedeño, Ken Griffey Jr., Andruw Jones, Mike Trout, and Crow-Armstrong himself. Among these players, Crow-Armstrong's 9.8 WAR is impressive, but he trails only Mays, Mantle, and Trout in this category. Tris Speaker and Ty Cobb were the only other center fielders to surpass this mark before integration. This puts Crow-Armstrong in rare company among baseball greats. Willie Davis, another young player who made an impact at a similar age, had a notable season with 8.4 WAR in 1964. However, his performance was largely driven by exceptional defensive metrics, whereas Crow-Armstrong's impressive numbers were more well-rounded. The trajectory of a player's career can be influenced by various factors, including their peak performance and longevity. A comparison between Pete Crow-Armstrong's (PCA) recent numbers and those of former players like Davis suggests that PCA may follow a similar path. Davis's career was marked by exceptional defensive metrics, which contributed significantly to his overall WAR figure. However, his offense never quite matched the high level he achieved in 1962, when he hit 20 home runs at just 22 years old. PCA's impressive performance has been well-rounded, unlike Davis's, who had a few standout seasons but struggled to replicate that level of success consistently. As PCA continues to rack up impressive stats, his career is beginning to resemble that of César Cedeño. Cedeño's early career was marked by exceptional talent and consistency, with the player amassing 49.4 WAR through his age-29 season. However, things took a turn for the worse after that point, with Cedeño managing only 3.6 WAR in his final six years. The story of Andruw Jones offers a more recent example of how a player's career can plateau. During his 12 seasons with the Braves, Jones was one of the league's top players, racking up 368 home runs and 61 WAR while being considered the best defensive center fielder in baseball. Jones' performance declined significantly after leaving the Braves, with the player accumulating only 1.7 WAR in his last five seasons. This sharp decline serves as a reminder that even exceptional players can experience a drop-off in production later in their careers. The trajectory of Pete Crow-Armstrong's career continues to be a subject of fascination among baseball enthusiasts. A closer examination of his statistical profile reveals some intriguing similarities with other all-time greats. For instance, his performance is often compared to that of Bryce Harper and Frank Robinson, both of whom were exceptional players in their prime. As the narrative goes, Crow-Armstrong's career may follow a similar path to these legends, where he would remain one of the best players in the game even if he takes a step back from being the absolute best. However, this assumption is based on the premise that his production will eventually decline as he approaches 30 years old. Crow-Armstrong has already demonstrated an ability and willingness to adapt at the plate, which sets him apart from others who may have plateaued or declined earlier in their careers. This adaptability raises questions about whether his skills will deteriorate suddenly, particularly when it comes to his hitting abilities. The experiences of other players offer a cautionary tale for Crow-Armstrong's potential trajectory. Mickey Mantle and Ken Griffey Jr., both of whom were considered among the greatest players of all time, saw their careers derailed by injuries in their 30s. These setbacks left them with impressive but incomplete resumes. The comparison between Crow-Armstrong and other legendary players is further complicated by the fact that his career has not yet reached its peak. Mike Trout's age-27 season provides a useful benchmark for evaluating Crow-Armstrong's progress, as it shows what can be achieved at this stage in one's career. The list of all-time great center fielders is an exclusive one, and Joe DiMaggio's name appears prominently on it. In career WAR among center fielders, he ranks seventh, a testament to his remarkable skills on the field. Comparing Crow-Armstrong's potential trajectory to that of DiMaggio is a useful exercise in evaluating his own career path. While PCA may be aiming high with his goals for 2026, coming close to DiMaggio's achievements would be an astonishing feat. DiMaggio's longevity and dominance on the field are legendary. Over an impressive span from age-23 to -35, he led the majors in WAR eight times, showcasing his incredible ability to perform consistently at a high level. His worst seasons during this period were still remarkably strong, with 7.6 and 7.8 WAR. DiMaggio's impressive statistics extend far beyond his WAR totals. He also led the league in several other categories, including runs, hits, triples, home runs, stolen bases, average, on-base percentage, slugging percentage, and OPS. His ability to excel in multiple aspects of the game is a key factor in his status as one of baseball's all-time greats. At age 40, DiMaggio was still producing at an elite level, posting 6.3 WAR and leading the NL with a .425 OBP. Even at 39, he managed 5.2 WAR, demonstrating his remarkable durability and ability to adapt to changing circumstances on the field. Pete Crow-Armstrong's remarkable performance in 2026 has earned him the National League MVP award, solidifying his position as one of the top players in the league. This achievement is a testament to his impressive skills and adaptability on the field, which have allowed him to make a significant impact at just 24 years old. Mays' career WAR of 156.2 ranks third among position players all-time, trailing only Barry Bonds and Babe Ruth. However, Crow-Armstrong's trajectory is unlikely to follow in their footsteps, with more modest expectations being placed on his future performance. A more realistic assessment would place him somewhere between Cedeño and Mantle in terms of long-term potential, a range that encompasses a significant variance in possible outcomes. articles.title: Google Announces Digital Keys for Google Wallet with Smart Lock Support
articles.summary: Google has announced that digital keys will soon be available in Google Wallet for use with smart locks at home as part of the Aliro standard.
articles.content: Google has announced that digital keys will soon be available in Google Wallet for use with smart locks at home. This is part of a new standard called Aliro, which enables seamless usability across multiple devices. Android users can now look forward to the same level of convenience as Apple device owners. The Schlage Sense Pro lock, which uses ultrawideband technology and Apple Home Keys in Apple Wallet, has set a benchmark for smart locks. Other manufacturers are adopting the Aliro standard to bring similar functionality to their products. This means that users will be able to enjoy hassle-free access to their homes without having to tap or wave their phones. The Schlage Sense Pro lock stands out for its ability to unlock doors automatically as the user approaches, using ultrawideband technology to sense their presence and speed. The autolock feature then locks the door again after a minute. This advanced version of Bluetooth is more reliable than older locking systems that require NFC connections or manual unlocking. The introduction of digital keys in Google Wallet brings Android users on par with Apple device owners, who have had access to similar functionality through Apple Wallet. As more manufacturers adopt the Aliro standard, users can expect increased convenience and flexibility when managing their smart locks at home. As users of Google Wallet explore its capabilities, they'll discover a range of convenient features when paired with compatible smart locks. This integration enables users to manage their home keys digitally, saving time by eliminating the need to fumble for their phone at the door. The added benefit of this technology is particularly useful in situations where hands are occupied or attention is focused elsewhere. For instance, users can unlock their doors without needing to physically interact with their device, making it a more seamless and efficient experience. To date, several smart locks have been certified as compatible with UWB (Ultra-Wideband) technology and the "unlock on approach" feature. These include the Schlage Sense Pro, Aqara u400, and Nuki Keypad 2 NFC lock, among others. More manufacturers are expected to join this list in the coming months. The Aliro standard, which underpins these advanced capabilities, was officially introduced earlier this year. As it gains broader adoption, users can look forward to further benefits such as improved security through encryption and enhanced battery life for their smart locks. The benefits of Google's digital wallet keys for home locks extend beyond just unlocking doors on approach. One advantage is the seamless integration with multiple locks, allowing users to easily share and manage access across different devices. This convenience factor is a significant draw for those looking to upgrade their smart lock systems. According to Google, its own home keys in Wallet will also enable NFC capabilities, eliminating the need for unlocking with just a tap of your phone. Furthermore, these digital keys can be synced across multiple compatible devices, ensuring that users have access to their homes even if they switch between phones or tablets. This level of flexibility is particularly useful for households with multiple occupants. Google's approach to guest management also differs from Apple's temporary passes. While guests and visitors can still add their own home keys to Wallet, they will need to obtain passcodes instead of being granted digital keys of their own. This added layer of security ensures that only authorized individuals have access to the home, even if a digital key is lost or compromised. For users who are concerned about the consequences of losing their phone, Google's system has a built-in backup plan. Most UWB locks can be accessed using keypad access codes, providing an alternative entry method in case of an emergency. However, some locks may not have physical key slots, which can limit options for emergency unlocking, as seen with Schlage's lock design that prioritizes security over traditional key-based access. To unlock the full potential of Google's digital wallet key feature, users need to navigate another layer of complexity beyond finding compatible locks. In addition to a compatible lock, an NFC-enabled Android phone running Android 9 or later is required, such as the Google Pixel 10 Pro or the more recent Pixel Fold. Furthermore, a Matter-enabled Google Hub with a Thread Border Router must be installed, which typically involves a separate device like a Nest Hub Max or a Nest Wifi Pro system. articles.title: Kitchen Scales Crucial for Baked Goods Consistency
articles.summary: A reliable kitchen scale is essential for producing consistent results in baked goods due to its precision and accuracy.
articles.content: A crucial tool in every baker's arsenal has been revealed: a reliable kitchen scale is essential for producing consistent results in baked goods. Baking recipes on our site consistently use gram measurements, a testament to the importance of precision in this craft. The Test Kitchen team agrees that accuracy is key when it comes to measuring ingredients. After extensive testing over several years and consulting with industry experts, we have identified top-performing kitchen scales for home cooks. The best overall kitchen scale is the Escali Primo Digital Food Scale, a standout choice among its peers due to its precision and ease of use. For those on a budget, however, the Amazon Basics Kitchen Scale offers excellent value without compromising on quality. For coffee aficionados who are also skilled bakers, the Fellow Tally Scale provides an added layer of precision when measuring ingredients for both their baked goods and specialty drinks. The Escali Primo holds a special place in the Bon Appétit Test Kitchen, having been a top choice for far longer than six years. Senior Test Kitchen editor Shilpa Uskokovic has relied on this scale for over a decade of her career, using it through long hours in pastry kitchens and frequent baking sessions. The Escali Primo's durability, accuracy, and affordability make it an ideal kitchen tool. Its lightweight design and variety of colors add to its appeal, while the simple two-button interface is easy to navigate. One of the standout features of this scale is its responsiveness and precision. In testing, it consistently delivered accurate readings and was quick to tare, making it a valuable asset in the kitchen. The 11-pound capacity of the Escali Primo is also noteworthy, allowing home cooks to tackle any task with confidence, and the 5-minute auto shut-off feature ensures that measurements are preserved even during long baking sessions. The Escali Primo's design makes it easy to use even when measuring into large mixing bowls. The elevated weighing platform is offset from the base, allowing for unobstructed viewing of the display or button operation. Cleaning up after a baking session is also a breeze with this scale. Its plastic body and sealed control panel are simple to wipe down, and stray crumbs won't get stuck in any crevices. One notable feature of the Escali Primo is its stable base. The four rubberized feet keep it firmly planted on your kitchen counter, preventing accidental slips or movements during use. The scale has stood the test of time, withstanding long-term testing without issue. Its durability is a significant factor in its popularity among our Test Kitchen editors. While it's not perfect, one limitation of the Escali Primo is its measurement precision. It can only measure in 1-gram increments, which may be sufficient for most baking needs but could be a drawback for coffee enthusiasts seeking greater accuracy. The display on the Escali Primo isn't backlit, unlike some pricier models, but this hasn't been a problem in our testing. However, it's worth noting that the scale doesn't have a touchscreen interface and requires a bit of pressure to operate its buttons. The Amazon Basics scale has a similar design to the Escali, but its buttons are not laminated to prevent crumbs or liquid from entering the crevices around them. Measuring 7 inches across, this scale is slightly larger than the Escali and features an elevated weighing platform that makes it easy to see the display. The platform itself is made of stainless steel, which is easy to wipe down. In testing, I found the Amazon Basics scale to be accurate, especially considering its price point. It responded quickly to weight addition or removal and provided a correct readout about 99% of the time. However, there were instances where the reading was off by a minor amount, specifically when repeatedly adding weight or switching between units of measurement. Removing what was on the scale, taring it, and starting over could resolve this issue. At $10 (at the time of writing), the Amazon Basics scale offers great value for its price. It's hard to find a better model at this price point, especially considering its performance in testing. The stainless-steel platform is more prone to scratching or smudging than the Escali's plastic one, but overall, this scale holds up well against other models on the list. The 5-pound maximum capacity of this scale makes it suitable for most home baking projects, covering a wide range of recipes and ingredients. For those who are passionate about precision in their brewing and baking techniques, this scale is an excellent choice, especially when compared to investing in separate scales for different tasks. One notable feature of the Tally's design is its tactile controls, which provide a satisfying user experience, complemented by an easy-to-read OLED display that showcases measurements in various units, including grams, ounces, pounds, and milliliters. The scale's elevated 6-inch platform offers ample space to hold a mixing bowl, allowing for clear visibility of the display while minimizing clutter in the workspace. A notable drawback is its price point, which may be excessive unless one values the special features it offers, particularly those related to coffee-making. The Oxo kitchen scale's design features a stainless-steel weighing platform that is easy to clean and maintain. A notable benefit of this scale is its handy pull-out display design, which makes it simple to measure ingredients into large bowls. Despite initial impressions, the Oxo scale was found to be off by 1 gram in some cases, particularly when the weight was placed at one corner of the platform. articles.title: SS United States Lies in Disrepair on Mobile River Bank
articles.summary: The SS United States, once a proud symbol of American maritime power, now lies in disrepair on the banks of Mobile River in Alabama.
articles.content: The SS United States, once a proud symbol of American maritime power, now lies in disrepair on the banks of Mobile River in Alabama. Past train tracks and deserted lots, this colossal vessel has been reduced to a shadow of its former self, its original red, white, and blue paint faded by rust and neglect. Measuring nearly 1,000 feet in length, the SS United States was always an extraordinary ship, boasting five more decks than the ill-fated RMS Titanic and a record-breaking speed that left all others behind. The ocean liner's heyday was marked by glamorous transatlantic crossings, with A-listers like Marilyn Monroe, Salvador Dalí, and Marlon Brando among its frequent passengers. Built in the early 1950s, it set sail on its maiden voyage from New York City to the UK in July 1952, achieving an unprecedented speed of just 3 days, 10 hours, and 40 minutes. The SS United States was more than just a luxury liner; it also played host to notable figures from politics, including former presidents Harry Truman and Dwight Eisenhower, and first ladies like Eleanor Roosevelt. Today, the ship's grandeur is tempered by its surroundings, a county jail, vacant lots, and past train tracks, but even in decline, it remains an awe-inspiring sight. The SS United States's glory days were short-lived, marked by a swift decline after just 17 years of passenger travel. A combination of factors led to its demise: affordable air travel made it harder for the ship to compete, rising oil and labor costs further squeezed profits, and government subsidies that once sustained it eventually dried up. The ship has spent nearly six decades in limbo, being bought and sold by various parties seeking a new purpose for this majestic vessel. In a surprising turn of events, the SS United States is now set to become an artificial reef off the coast of Destin, Florida, where it will provide a habitat for dozens of species of fish and other marine life. On November 12, the liner will be intentionally sunk into the ocean floor, marking a new chapter in its history as a recreational destination for divers and fishermen. The narrow plank leading up to the ship's port side was a precursor to what lay ahead - a journey through the remnants of luxury and grandeur. Inside, the light was scarce, filtering in from gaps where windows and portholes had once stood, casting eerie shadows on the walls. A spiral staircase wound its way up two floors above, where first-class cabins had once been the epitome of elegance. Now, outlines of floor plans remained etched into the metal, alongside shower and toilet drains that hinted at the opulence of bygone days. The grand staircase, though partially intact, led to a promenade deck once lined with floor-to-ceiling windows, now exposed to the elements. The empty lounges where martinis were no doubt served in their heyday still held an air of sophistication, even if it was now tinged with neglect. As we navigated through the ship's interior, I couldn't help but imagine the ghosts of jazz bands past playing on hollowed-out stages. The captain's dining room, once the preserve of elite guests, now hosted a different kind of diner - spiders scurrying across the tables. The ecosystem surrounding the ship will likely take at least a year to fully establish itself after it sinks into the waters off Destin-Fort Walton Beach. A key factor contributing to this delay is the lack of natural reefs and habitats in these waters, which are typical in other parts of Florida. However, artificial reefs can provide an alternative environment for marine life to thrive, compensating for the absence of natural features. More than 600 artificial reefs have been installed in the area since 2017, thanks in part to the efforts of local leaders who recognize their potential to boost diving and fishing opportunities. The SS United States was identified as a prime candidate to become one of these artificial reefs after being located by Fogg through online research. The SS United States was purchased from the conservancy after various deals to refurbish or repurpose the ship fell through, including a plan to turn it into a recreational destination at Pier 76 in Manhattan. A major challenge lay ahead: getting the massive vessel out of Philadelphia and transported to its final resting place. A detailed survey and negotiations with the Coast Guard were necessary before the ship could begin its journey. The SS United States finally arrived in Mobile, Alabama, in March 2025, where it underwent an extensive environmental remediation process to prepare it for its new life as an artificial reef. Years earlier, asbestos had been removed from the cabins, but a specialized team still had work to do. The ship's fuel tanks, ventilation system, and other hazardous materials were carefully cleaned out and disposed of responsibly. The elevators, which were covered in grease, were also removed to facilitate the sinking process and allow air to escape quickly. The sinking process has been designed to be more controlled and less destructive than in the past, with explosives no longer used. Instead, valves connected to large boiler pipes will be opened to allow water to flood into the ship. According to calculations by a naval architect on the project, it is estimated that the SS United States will be fully submerged within 45 minutes of these valves being opened. This means that the wreck can be quickly surveyed and any remaining equipment removed, such as IMAX cameras that have been mounted to capture footage of the sinking. The next day after the sinking, Fogg expects a group of recreational divers to arrive on site, eager to explore the newly submerged ship. Above water, visitor center exhibits and a land-based museum will also soon open, showcasing artifacts and stories from the SS United States' past that have been carefully preserved by the conservancy. The SS United States will once again become a source of wonder and delight for the public, with Jones taking comfort in knowing that the ship's legacy will live on through these exhibits and museums. articles.title: Bull shark spotted at Great Sea Reef in northeast Fiji
articles.summary: A scuba diver witnessed a majestic bull shark in its natural habitat while exploring the Great Sea Reef in northeast Fiji.
articles.content: A scuba diver's dream come true: witnessing a majestic bull shark in its natural habitat. The creature emerged from the depths of the South Pacific Ocean in an instant, its imposing size and bulk evident even at 60 feet below. Floating alongside the shark were two remora fish, their sleek bodies gliding effortlessly through the water as if guarding their larger companion. The bull shark itself moved with surprising speed, given its considerable girth, as it swam just above the sandy sea floor. As the shark turned in the water, a wall of vibrant coral rose up from the depths to the right, a kaleidoscope of colors - neon green, milky orange, and soft pink - that seemed almost otherworldly. Meanwhile, deep water beckoned to the left, an endless expanse of blue that stretched out into the distance. A fellow diver floated nearby, clad in a striking speckled camouflage wetsuit that blended seamlessly with the surrounding environment. His wild hair was visible above his mask, and he gave a nod of acknowledgement as he flattened the side of his hand against his head - a universal sign for one of the most coveted sightings in diving: a shark. The sighting was all the more remarkable given the relatively unknown status of the Great Sea Reef, a 280-mile-long underwater paradise in northeast Fiji. This coral reef system is not only home to an astonishing array of marine life but also boasts a staggering three-quarters of all known coral species and over half of all recognized fish. As a hub for conservation research, the Great Sea Reef is gaining recognition, with organizations such as PADI AWARE and the World Wildlife Fund launching initiatives to promote community-backed ocean conservation. In July 2026, a new partnership was announced to take this effort forward. A groundbreaking collaboration between PADI AWARE and WWF is revolutionizing the way we approach marine conservation by harnessing the power of scuba diving communities worldwide. The Global Shark & Ray Census project aims to collect vital data that can inform governments in Fiji and beyond about the creation of new Marine Protected Areas, a crucial step towards safeguarding coral reefs. PADI AWARE's programs director Ian Campbell is driving this ambitious initiative forward by bringing together PADI's vast network of certified divers and dive centers with WWF's conservation efforts spanning over 100 countries. As I explored the Great Sea Reef, I was struck by the unique opportunity for travelers to experience this ecosystem firsthand while contributing to a pioneering approach to coral reef protection. My morning dive was filled with excitement when we spotted a lone bull shark, which I documented in my waterproof notebook with a simple yet satisfying "bull shark: 1. The notes from that dive were just the beginning of the data collection process, and it was only when we returned to land that our logging efforts would truly begin. The winding path leading to Nukubati resort was flanked by coconut trees whose angled heights seemed to stretch up towards the sky. Opened in 1992 by Jenny Leewai and her Australian husband Peter Bourke, this Fijian resort has been a family affair for two generations. Nestled on the shores of the Great Sea Reef, Nukubati is the only property located within the reef's boundaries, making it an ideal base for exploring the area. After each dive, guests would return to the resort and be greeted by its tranquil atmosphere, complete with custom-ordered cane palm furniture and gleaming wooden floors that seemed to reflect the light of the sun. The private bure where I stayed was a cozy haven, equipped with all the necessary amenities, including a hot shower that helped wash away the fatigue of the dive. As I joined the others at the open-air lounge, nicknamed the pavilion, I couldn't help but notice the relaxed atmosphere that pervaded the resort. Jenny and Lara were already seated on the couch, looking every bit the epitome of island elegance in their casual attire, with Jenny sporting a caftan and Champagne-colored pearls. As we made our way back to shore after spotting those sharks, I took out my phone and logged the sighting on the PADI AWARE app. It was quick and straightforward - just a few minutes of tapping through details like our location, activity, maximum depth, and the types of sharks we'd seen. We marked Fish Market as our dive site, recorded our underwater excursion as diving, noted that we hadn't gone below 60 feet, and identified the species we'd encountered. The census has gained significant traction since its launch in April 2026, with over 212,000 people participating worldwide and submitting thousands of sightings. These reports are then reviewed by PADI AWARE staff, who work closely with experts from the James Cook University Centre for Sustainable Tropical Fisheries and Aquaculture in Australia to ensure the accuracy of the data. Researchers have already made use of this information - a scientific paper currently under review has incorporated some of the census findings. Moreover, images submitted through the app have helped confirm the presence of four shark and ray species in Vanuatu. The great hammerhead shark is among those species, listed as Critically Endangered" on the IUCN Red List due to its impressive size - up to 20 feet long - and mysterious mating behaviors. Fiji's Marine Protected Areas have proven to be a successful model for conservation, safeguarding reefs for both locals and travelers while providing new economic opportunities for communities. Nukubati Resort stands out as an exemplary case of how tourism can positively impact the environment and local economies, often without visitors even realizing it at first. The resort has been a hub for sustainable practices and eco-friendly initiatives that benefit both the surrounding ecosystem and its guests. During my stay at Nukubati, I had the privilege of witnessing multiple shark and ray species thriving in their natural habitat, free from human influence such as feeding or baiting. This was not an isolated incident; every single dive I went on featured these incredible creatures. The statistics are certainly eye-opening, making diving on the Great Sea Reef an attractive option for both seasoned scuba enthusiasts and beginners alike. With options available for snorkelers, beginner divers, and advanced divers, there's something for everyone to enjoy in this unique marine environment. As a PADI scuba diving instructor with extensive experience worldwide, Vincent was keenly aware of the reef's significance during our excursion. He pointed out that the absence of sharks on every dive was indeed remarkable, especially considering we were the only boat present at the site. The Great Sea Reef holds a special place in the hearts and histories of local communities, who have revered it for generations through songs, stories, and cultural traditions. Its importance extends beyond its natural beauty to its role as a protector of their community's heritage. Locals like Leone are now being recognized as traditional stakeholders in the GSR's future, a shift that acknowledges their deep connection to the reef. Their unshakeable faith in the reef's importance is evident in the way they've nurtured Nukubati Island Resort, which has endured numerous challenges and still remains a tranquil hideaway for just 14 guests. The property's resilience can be attributed to its strong family and community bonds, with all 100 staff members being local residents who have helped keep it afloat through thick and thin. Nukubati has also been at the forefront of sustainability, having run on solar power since its inception in the 1990s, thanks to co-founder Peter's hand-engineered system. The recognition of Nukubati as a PADI Eco Center in September 2026 marked a significant milestone for the resort and its operator, Great Sea Reef Divers, which demonstrated their commitment to conservation and sustainability. This designation has allowed Leone and his team to contribute to global initiatives, such as logging shark and ray sightings in the new census, and encouraging visitors to participate in these efforts. As they dive into the crystal-clear waters of the GSR, Leone's enthusiasm is palpable, with no regrets about their decision to prioritize conservation over commercial interests. articles.title: Prada's Spring/Summer 2027 Collection Emphasizes Skirts as Must-Have Item
articles.summary: The collection featured 63 distinct looks showcasing unique takes on the skirt in various colors and fabrics.
articles.content: Prada's Spring/Summer 2027 show was a defining moment for skirts in the fashion world this year, establishing them as a must-have item for the season. Miuccia Prada's collection featured 63 distinct looks, each showcasing a unique take on the skirt in various colors and fabrics. The presentation was a masterclass in skirt design, with every iteration bringing something new to the table. While the silhouette of the skirts may have seemed fresh and innovative under the spring collections' glamorous lights, they actually made a similar impact during the fall shows. However, it's worth noting that the primary message wasn't necessarily about the garment itself. As the temperature drops, people naturally turn to clothing that offers maximum coverage, often opting for pants in thick wool or denim. But with the weather becoming brisker, there is still hope for the skirt's resurgence. As autumn's chill sets in, outdoor enthusiasts are flocking to the countryside for a breath of fresh air and a change of scenery. Country pursuits like hiking and horseback riding offer a great way to get some exercise while taking in the vibrant fall foliage. Dressing for a day outdoors requires layers that can keep up with changing weather conditions. A long, box-pleated corduroy skirt paired with a lightweight cashmere turtleneck and a plaid shirt provides a comfortable and practical outfit for exploring the great outdoors. Mixing suede and turquoise accents is a key element in channeling the New Western look without going overboard. Pairing these elements with more everyday pieces, such as a concho belt or jewelry, adds a touch of elegance to an otherwise rugged ensemble. To add some flair to your fall wardrobe, think about combining classic pieces with more adventurous elements. A vintage-inspired gray hoodie can be paired with high-shaft boots featuring croc-embossed details that evoke a rugged Old West feel without going over the top. While muted tones and neutrals are often a safe choice for fall dressing, don't be afraid to introduce some brighter colors into your outfit. You could incorporate an interesting pop of red or purple, which is especially fitting during this time of year. The key is to balance bold hues with more subdued pieces. Consider pairing a vibrant taffeta ball skirt in a pinkish-red shade with a coordinating button-down shirt and a statement-making ring featuring peridot stones surrounded by studded enamel starfish designs. This look would be perfect for hosting friends or attending holiday gatherings, adding a touch of personality to your overall ensemble. To balance out a leather skirt's edginess, try pairing it with a simple white T-shirt and a V-neck sweater in a muted gray tone. This subtle combination helps to soften the overall look without compromising its downtown cool factor. The result is a stylish ensemble perfect for everyday wear. For a more relaxed office look, consider swapping out heels or boots for slip-on loafers. This understated footwear choice pairs well with a utilitarian skirt and lets personal style take center stage. Office attire has indeed become more laid-back in recent years, allowing individuals to express their unique sense of fashion. When incorporating bold animal prints into your wardrobe, remember that they can be statement pieces on their own. Pairing them with understated items like striped monk-collar shirts or knitted vests in unexpected color combinations adds visual interest and creates a chic look. These contrasting elements work well together, making the overall ensemble truly eye-catching. The skirt's bold print demands to be noticed, so pair it with understated basics like a black cashmere T-shirt with short sleeves and a wool cardigan to let the eye-catching pattern take center stage. This well-balanced combination prevents the overall look from feeling overwhelming, allowing the wearer's personality to shine through in the statement-making skirt.
